messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together a manager-facing onboarding checklist for our new hire Taylor (start: Mon 2025-06-02). Goal: align manager + HR + IT + buddy on first-week agenda, access, and a clean 30/60/90 handoff. Draft below, please review and add anything obvious.

Aisha: DRAFT checklist (manager responsibilities) — short and actionable:
- Pre-boarding: confirm laptop + accounts, share org chart, invite to team channel.
- Day 1: 30m team intro, 60m role/expectations w/manager, setup dev env with buddy.
- Day 2: Access deep-dive (prod access gating, secrets, KMS owner).
- Week 1: schedule stakeholder intros, quick wins + sample tickets.
- 30/60/90: manager to draft initial goals and review at end of week 1.
- Admin: confirm payroll/benefits onboarding checklist complete.

Miguel: Thanks — looks good. Quick q: who owns laptop ordering? I need serial ETA to plan Day 0 setup. @Keiko?

Keiko: I can take that. We'll need full name + preferred OS + office/home shipping addr. I can queue a rush order if requested.

Keiko: Ops ticket command if helpful:
```
iticket create --category hardware --item "laptop: 16" macbook pro" --user taylor@example.com --priority high
```
(Replace email/OS as needed.)

Sam: I can be Taylor's buddy. Happy to own Day 1 dev env pairing and the first-week walkthrough. Suggest 30-min daily sync Mon-Fri for the first week — helps catch infra gaps.

Aisha: Awesome — @Sam please send recurring invites. Also linking the 30/60/90 template I usually recommend for managers: https://redwood.internal/manager-30-60-90 (copyable). Managers: write 3 measurable goals for 30/60/90 (product, infra, collaboration).

OnboardBot: Reminder: new-hire forms (ID, tax, NDA) must be completed 48h before start. HR contact: hr@redwood.com :memo:

Miguel: For calendar invites, can we standardize the 1:1 kickoff text? I usually use: 
```
Subject: Welcome Taylor — 1:1 Kickoff
When: Mon 10:00 AM (30-45m)
Agenda: intros, role context, immediate priorities, 30/60/90 expectations
```
I'll send that once Keiko confirms laptop ETA.

Aisha: Perfect. One more ask for managers — log any access or infra blockers in the "onboarding-blockers" channel thread and tag eng-infra. That gives us an auditable trail for follow-ups.

Miguel: Got it — will post blockers if anything pops. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Thank you all — if no further edits by EOD Friday I'll mark this as the official manager checklist for Taylor and spin up calendar invites.

Keiko: Laptop ordered (rush). ETA Fri 2025-05-30. Will update shipping tracking in this thread.

Sam: Invite sent for buddy syncs Mon-Fri 10:30-11:00 for first week.

OnboardBot: New hire onboarding packet emailed to taylor@example.com (automated).

Miguel: All good from me.
